tools.name: connect_wallet
tools.description: Opens the wallet-connection panel so the user can connect a wallet. The user completes the connection manually; this tool never selects a wallet or signs anything. Calling it again while the panel is already open (or a wallet is already connected) is a no-op.

tools.name: get_wallet_status
tools.description: Returns the connected EVM and Solana wallet addresses (null when not connected) and the currently selected chain.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigates to a 1inch.com page. Page-scoped tools (swap, limit orders, Aqua) become available after opening their page.

page.description: Target page: simple swap, advanced trade, pro trading, Aqua overview, or Aqua create.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Searches the curated 1inch token list by symbol, name, or address and returns candidates with their exact addresses and decimals. Use the returned address in other tools.

chainId.description: Chain id to search on. Defaults to the selected chain.

tools.name: swap_configure
tools.description: Updates the visible swap form: source/destination token (symbol or address), human-readable amount, and optionally the chain. Waits for the refreshed quote and returns the resulting form state.

amount.description: Source amount in human-readable units, e.g. "1.5".

chainId.description: Chain id to swap on (switches the form when supported).

dstChainId.description: Destination chain id for a cross-chain swap.

tools.name: swap_execute
tools.description: Submits the currently configured swap through the standard flow. The user must confirm every transaction in their wallet; this tool can never move funds silently.

tools.name: swap_get_quote
tools.description: Returns the current swap quote for the visible form: tokens, amounts, swap type, quote errors, and whether the swap is ready to execute.
